# QRCode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A native, high-performance, vector-based QR Code element. Implements a full ISO/IEC 18004 compliant encoder with Reed-Solomon error correction, data masking, and automatic version selection. Optimized to generate the smallest possible PDF payload by coalescing adjacent modules.

Copyright (c) Project Nayuki. (MIT License) https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library Ported to C# for BonniePDF.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text description for accessibility (e.g. "QR code to https://example.com"). When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the QR code. Required by PDF/UA for non-decorative figures.

### `BackgroundColor`

```csharp
Color BackgroundColor { get; set; }
```

The background color of the QR code (usually white).

### `Data`

```csharp
string Data { get; set; }
```

The data/text to encode in the QR Code.

### `DrawBackground`

```csharp
bool DrawBackground { get; set; }
```

Whether to draw the background color. If false, the QR code will be transparent.

### `ErrorCorrection`

```csharp
QrErrorCorrection ErrorCorrection { get; set; }
```

The error correction level to use. Higher levels provide more redundancy at the cost of reduced data capacity. Default is Medium (~15%).

### `ForegroundColor`

```csharp
Color ForegroundColor { get; set; }
```

The color of the QR code modules (usually black).

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When `true`, the QR code is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning. Rare for QR codes (they're almost always meaningful) - included for symmetry with `Image.IsDecorative`.

### `QuietZone`

```csharp
int QuietZone { get; set; }
```

Number of quiet-zone modules around the QR code. The ISO/IEC 18004 standard specifies 4 modules. Default is 4. Set to 0 to disable the quiet zone.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `Size`

```csharp
float Size { get; set; }
```

The display size of the QR Code (QR codes are always square).
